name: hazel_weir_central_procedural_graph
description: Optimized Central Procedural Graph featuring Day 4 10-hand workforce sprint, 16-18 bounded land expansion, Day 30 Town Shop arbitrage, batched cyclical peak monetization, crop maturation phase gates, and cluster harvesting dispatch.

nodes.name: State & Balance Audit
nodes.description: Computes net available cash, shed fill percentage, wage liability, active shop contract demand, oracle price signals, uncommitted inventory surplus, and remaining days to crop maturation horizons.

nodes.name: Midnight Wage Reserve Defense
nodes.description: Protects payroll for all active hired hands. Enforces dynamic cash reserve locks and triggers pre-midnight surplus liquidation to prevent the 0-hand bankruptcy cascade.

nodes.name: Town Shop Demand Arbitrage
nodes.description: Preemptively matches unlocked town shop demand surges and immediately fulfills mature high-margin crops (Carrots, Tomatoes, Pumpkins, Strawberries) to capture 2.0x-3.5x contract price premiums through Day 30.

nodes.name: Shed Headroom & Cyclical Monetization
nodes.description: Manages shed capacity and proactive monetization. Prevents 100/100 discard drops and captures cyclical price premiums (>= 1.10x-1.25x base) on uncommitted surplus while strictly safeguarding livestock feed and active town shop contracts.

nodes.name: Oracle Opponent Front-Run
nodes.description: Reads 96-step TTM forecast to dump sensitive commodities (Wool, Milk, Strawberry) immediately before opponent market gluts collapse prices.

nodes.name: Capital Reinvestment & Yield Scaling
nodes.description: Reinvests surplus cash beyond wage reserves into early workforce acceleration (10-hand sprint by Day 4), bounded contiguous land expansion (16-18 plots), commercial seeds gated by maturation horizons, and fertilizer.

nodes.name: Routine Farm & Workforce Execution
nodes.description: Executes field routines with strict operational sequencing: cluster harvest mature crops, urgent crop watering, worker drop-offs, livestock feeding, phase-gated planting, and Day 30 terminal harvest clearing.

attributes.guidance: Cancel non-essential purchases (BUY_SEED, BUY_ANIMAL, BUY_LAND, redundant HIRE); schedule worker harvest drop-offs before hour 21; enforce emergency liquidation of non-feed, non-contract inventory at hour >= 20 to guarantee payroll.
attributes.pitfalls: Never sell Wheat below dynamic livestock feed reserve ((n_animals > 0) ? max(4, n_animals * 3) : 0); do not rely on low-margin fertilizer sales to cover payroll deficits; never liquidate crops committed to active town shop delivery.

attributes.condition: has_unlocked_shops and (net_available_cash >= 180.0 or shop_deliverable_inventory > 0) and day <= 30
attributes.guidance: Allocate up to 3 market order slots to deliver matching mature shed inventory directly to town shops for 2.0x-3.5x contract premium through Day 30; procure shop-demanded seeds (Carrots, Tomatoes, Pumpkins) within their maturation phase gates when surplus cash covers seed costs and wage buffers.
attributes.pitfalls: Do not commit seed capital if net cash falls below 1.25x midnight payroll reserve; never purchase long-cycle shop seeds past their maturation phase gates (Pumpkins Day 23, Tomatoes Day 25, Carrots Day 27); never hold shop produce past contract expiration windows; prioritize town shop contracts over standard market sales.

attributes.condition: (shed_used + incoming_worker_inventory >= 80) or (shed_used >= 35 and has_uncommitted_peak_surplus and hour % 3 == 0) or (day == 30 and hour >= 20 and shed_used > 0)
attributes.guidance: Execute batch liquidations using at most 2 market order slots to protect worker action bandwidth: 1) At moderate shed fill (35%-79%), monetize uncommitted surplus commodities when spot/oracle price reaches cyclical peaks (>= 1.10x-1.25x base price); 2) When shed fill reaches >= 80%, liquidate uncommitted non-feed inventory with price >= 0.70x base price (relax to 0.45x only if shed >= 95% to prevent discard drops); 3) On Day 30 at hour >= 20, liquidate all remaining inventory at market price for terminal cash maximization.
attributes.pitfalls: Never sell commodities committed to active or pending town shop contracts; never liquidate Wheat below dynamic livestock feed reserve ((n_animals > 0) ? max(4, n_animals * 3) : 0); never fire-sell below 0.70x base price unless shed_used >= 95%; limit sales to 2 order slots per step to preserve worker movement bandwidth.

attributes.guidance: Preempt lowest-margin open orders; execute rapid batch liquidations of vulnerable commodities (Wool, Milk, Strawberry) while current market price remains favorable (> 0.75 * base_price) before opponent dumping collapses market prices.
attributes.pitfalls: Do not dump into already collapsed sub-0.50 base price markets unless shed overflow is imminent; do not front-run commodities committed to active town shop contracts; respect livestock feed reserve ((n_animals > 0) ? max(4, n_animals * 3) : 0).

attributes.condition: day <= 29 and net_available_cash >= (day <= 4 ? midnight_payroll_due * 1.15 : midnight_payroll_due * 1.25 + 100.0) and (hired_hands < 10 or uncultivated_plots > 0 or (total_plots < 18 and uncultivated_plots <= 1 and day <= 20) or has_fertilizer_deficit)
attributes.guidance: Sprint workforce scaling to 10-hand cap by Day 4 using lean 1.15x payroll buffer. Expand contiguous land acreage up to 16-18 total plots only when existing plots are fully cultivated (uncultivated_plots <= 1) through Day 20. Enforce strict crop maturation phase gates for seed purchases: halt Pumpkins after Day 23, Tomatoes after Day 25, and Carrots after Day 27; restrict Days 28-29 purchases strictly to fast-maturing Wheat if margin is positive. Fully halt seed, land, and hiring purchases on Day 30.
attributes.pitfalls: Never purchase land beyond 18 contiguous plots to avoid transit and watering bottlenecks; never acquire land when uncultivated_plots > 1; never buy seeds past their maturation phase gate deadlines; do not purchase land, animals, or hire hands after Day 20; halt all purchasing on Day 30 to maximize terminal net cash.

attributes.guidance: Dispatch active hands strictly by operational priority: 1) Cluster harvest adjacent mature crops until hands reach full carry capacity before initiating shed drop-offs, avoiding single-item round trips; 2) Urgent watering of dry planted crops to prevent growth stalls; 3) Drop off carried inventory at shed when full or near shift end; 4) Feed livestock if animals present; 5) Plant seeds adhering to maturation phase gates; 6) Clear weeds and till ground. On Day 30, halt all tilling, weeding, and planting entirely to dedicate 100% of workforce bandwidth to harvesting ripe plots and depositing all carried items to the shed before step 716 for final liquidation.
attributes.pitfalls: Do not make shed drop-off trips with partial carry loads when adjacent mature crops are harvestable; never prioritize weeding or tilling over watering and harvesting; halt all planting and land work on Day 30; ensure all hands deposit carried items at shed prior to step 716 to avoid stranded inventory at game end.
